meta.title: Allow Partial Bidding (rfq.bid.allow_partial) = ON
gaps: Set tenant setting rfq.bid.allow_partial to ON as a Tenant Admin.

Select or verify the required configurable RFQ templates with line terms, global terms, and formulas because no template names are provided and the catalog cannot inspect template capabilities beyond selection.
Submit a vendor bid for only a subset of RFQ line items; vendor_bid fills every price cell and has no partial-line selection argument.
Compare the ON behaviour with the setting OFF or prove that the two tenant configurations differ.
Verify the stated split-award and multiple-PO business impact.
